items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bunny and I were great friends. If I had a date, I would ask Bunny to play.

ctx.x: That’s right. The first recording of that.
Most people don’t know that. Bunny and I were great friends. If I had a date, I would ask Bunny to play.
Yeah, you made some nice records with Bunny.
